answer: Use a randomized audit lottery: each epoch, 5% of identities are drawn by public seed and must prove a unique device-bound deposit of 30 tokens within 3 epochs. A beacon of verifiable randomness picks them, so a grove of 100 clones faces about 5 audits per epoch, each costing a fresh deposit. Failure slashes 60%, pushing the profit horizon out of reach, and anyone can verify draws from the seed.
